sources.title: Traffic Signs Detection using YOLO11N - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project presents a model trained with the YOLO11N architecture to detect traffic signs. The training process includes log files, graphs, and weight files, allowing for a detailed analysis of model performance.

sources.snippet: Traffic sign recognition is still one of the challenging aspects of intelligent vehicle systems, mainly when processor or memory resources are limited. sources.snippet: Consequently, achieving robust detection of small-scale traffic signs under diverse conditions remains a persistent challenge. This paper introduces PBM_YOLO, a model that significantly enhances the YOLOv11n baseline to overcome these limitations.
